scope: Catalogue investigation of every pair pending at the start of this review, with focused literature follow-up for selected systems. This is not an exhaustive literature survey or an observational validation.
numericalMethod: Independent SciPy 1.13.1 bracketed Kepler solve and true-anomaly projection; ERFA 2.0.1.5 IAU 2006 precession for equinox-of-date PA.

candidates.name: 85 Pegasi
candidates.keplerMassCaveat: Diagnostic mass sum only; catalogue distance and hierarchy can be wrong. Does not determine the component mass ratio.

literatureReview.name: 85 Pegasi
literatureReview.finding: The secondary has been discussed as a close binary in published stellar-model calibrations. The S99 photometric ratio alone is not a secure subsystem mass ratio. Hipparcos has a stochastic X solution rather than an explicit barycentre.
literatureReview.nextStep: Reconcile the A–(Ba+Bb) mass budget and absolute astrometry; distinguish measured dynamical constraints from stellar-model masses and proposed companions.
